rules.note: LOCKED team layer: the agent never deletes mail or messages — deletion is irreversible, destroys the audit trail, and is the classic cover-your-tracks move. A human deletes by hand if it must happen.
Filter, rule, and settings changes silently redirect all future mail — forwarding rules are the classic inbox-takeover move, so they are the owner's hands only, however the change is classified.
A send carrying an attachment or addressed to an external recipient can leak data outside the organization; it routes to the owner instead of executing or asking this run's approver.
Plain sending asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. Nothing in the payload downgrades this ask; only the human approval flow clears it.
Reading, searching, and opening threads are free for every initiator, including unattended routines — triage is the agent's day job.
Creating and editing drafts is free: a draft leaves nothing sent, and the send action itself asks or hands off. If nobody has received it yet, the agent may prepare it freely.
